guidance.heading: Specified by force, not by WLL
guidance.body: Mining and conveyor chain is chosen by size (diameter × pitch), strength grade and fatigue class, and is rated by its test force and minimum breaking force. It carries no working load limit and is never used for lifting. Order chain and connectors of the same size and grade, and in matched lengths where the conveyor runs twin strands.

standards.heading: DIN 22252, 22255, 22253 and 22258
standards.body: DIN 22252 covers round link chain for conveyors and mining machinery in grades B, C and D; DIN 22255 the lower-profile flat link chain; DIN 22253 the open connecting link; and DIN 22258-1 the block connecting link. DIN 20637 covers long link chain for monorail suspension.

items.q: Is mining chain rated for lifting?
items.a: No. It is rated by test and breaking force for conveyor duty and has no working load limit. Lifting calls for Grade 80 or Grade 100 alloy chain.

items.q: Do you supply chain wheels and sprockets?
items.a: Yes. Plain, segmented, pocket and toothed wheels for DIN 764 and DIN 766 round steel chain are made to order; send the chain size, the wheel diameter or tooth count and the shaft bore.

items.q: Do the parts come with test certificates?
items.a: Yes. Each consignment ships with the manufacturer's test certificate, giving the test and breaking forces of the batch.

Fixed-shank plough anchor of the Delta pattern, classed as high holding power (HHP). The one-piece fabricated body has no hinge, so it sets quickly and holds well in sand and mud, which is why it is common on offshore support vessels, workboats and as a mooring anchor.

Sizes and ratings

23 sizes, 300 kg to 20,000 kg. Proof test load 98 to 1,840 kN, as the manufacturer applies it. Every row has its own Indus part number in the table below. The lettered dimensions refer to the dimension drawing in the gallery.

Choosing an anchor

Each mass in the table has its overall dimensions and the proof test load the manufacturer applies. Size the anchor by mass to the class rules for the vessel; as an HHP type, class rules generally allow it at a lower mass than a conventional stockless anchor.

Ordering

Quote the Indus part number from the table, or send the size you need. Each consignment ships with the manufacturer's test certificate; say on the RFQ if your site needs anything more.

faqs.question: How is the anchor size chosen?
faqs.answer: By mass. A ship's anchors are sized from its equipment number under the classification society's rules, which give the anchor mass and the matching anchor chain. For an existing vessel, match the mass and type already carried; for a new installation, send us the equipment number or the class requirement.

faqs.question: Can the anchor be supplied with a class certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes, on request. State the classification society (ABS, BV, CCS, DNV, LR, NK and others) on the RFQ and the anchor is proof tested and certified to that society's rules.

products.title: Segmented Plain Wheel for Bucket Elevator Chain
products.focusKeyword: segmented plain wheel for bucket elevator chain
products.descriptionShort: Segmented Plain Wheel for Bucket Elevator Chain, 18 sizes, Ø 450 mm to Ø 800 mm. Made to order with Indus part numbers.
products.descriptionLong:
Plain chain wheel with bolted, replaceable rim segments, for bucket elevators and conveyors running DIN 764 or DIN 766 round steel chain. Worn segments are changed without taking the wheel off the shaft.

Sizes

18 sizes, Ø 450 mm to Ø 800 mm. Every row has its own Indus part number in the table below. The lettered dimensions refer to the dimension drawing in the gallery.

Choosing a size

Choose by chain size and nominal diameter; the lettered dimensions refer to the drawing in the gallery. The hub bore and keyway are machined to order.

Ordering

Quote the Indus part number from the table, or send the size you need. Each consignment ships with the manufacturer's inspection certificate; say on the RFQ if your site needs anything more.

products.title: Grade 60 Stainless Steel Lifting Chain
products.descriptionShort: Grade 60 Stainless Steel Lifting Chain, 12 sizes, 3 mm to 26 mm, WLL 0.2 to 15 t. Indus part numbers, manufacturer's test certificate.
products.descriptionLong:
Short link lifting chain in stainless steel to a Grade 60 rating, from 3 mm to 26 mm. AISI 316L covers the smaller sizes and 318LN duplex the larger ones, for lifting in food, pharmaceutical, chemical and marine plant where carbon steel chain would corrode.

Sizes and ratings

12 sizes, 3 mm to 26 mm. Working load limit 0.2 to 15 t. Every row has its own Indus part number in the table below.

Choosing a size

Choose by working load limit for a straight vertical lift, at a 4:1 design factor; in a multi-leg sling the leg angle reduces the rating as for any chain sling. Use it with stainless fittings of a matching rating, never with a lower-rated part.

Ordering

Quote the Indus part number from the table, or send the size and grade you need. Each consignment ships with the manufacturer's test certificate; say on the RFQ if your site needs anything more.
products.seoDescription: Grade 60 Stainless Steel Lifting Chain: 12 sizes, 3 mm to 26 mm. Indus part numbers and test certificate. Request a quote.

faqs.question: What sizes does the Grade 60 stainless steel lifting chain come in?
faqs.answer: 12 sizes, 3 mm to 26 mm. The table lists each with its Indus part number and ratings.

faqs.question: What is the working load limit?
faqs.answer: 0.2 to 15 t, depending on size, as the manufacturer rates it. The WLL is the most the chain may carry in service; proof and breaking loads are test figures and never working limits.

faqs.question: Do the parts come with a test certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each consignment ships with the manufacturer's test certificate. For third-party certification or witnessed proof testing, say so on the RFQ.

specs.value: AISI 316L to 16 mm; AISI 318LN duplex from 16 mm
